OsIfCounterConfig.constraint: When OsIfUseSystemTimer=true and OsIfMulticoreSupport=false, OsIfCounterConfig must have EXACTLY ONE counter struct.

counter_struct.Name: OsIfCounterConfig_0

OsIfSystemTimerClockRef.description: McuClockReferencePoint reference; leave empty array when no core-clock ref exists in project.

counter_struct.mutual_exclusion: In baremetal, use EITHER OsIfSystemTimerClockRef OR OsIfSystemTimerClockFreq (not both).
